title: Full-Stack Developer (React.js / Next.js / Node.js)
description:
Hiring: Full Stack Web Developer

**Company:** Metahud  
**Project:** Aroma (SaaS Platform)  
**Salary:** ₹15,000–₹22,000/month  
**Work Mode:** Remote / Work From Office (Kolkata)  
**Employment:** Full-Time

We are looking for a skilled **Full Stack Web Developer** to develop, maintain, and improve our SaaS product, Aroma. The candidate should be capable of independently handling frontend, backend, database management, deployment, and integration of new features.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js, and Next.js.
* Experience with Node.js, Express.js, and REST APIs.
* Database management using PostgreSQL, Supabase, and Prisma ORM.
* Experience with Tailwind CSS and responsive UI/UX development.
* Knowledge of authentication, user roles, admin dashboards, and subscription-based SaaS platforms.
* Experience with GitHub, version control, hosting, and deployment (Vercel, Bluehost, etc.).
* Ability to debug, optimize, maintain, and scale existing applications.
* Knowledge of payment gateway integration, bulk product uploads, and third-party APIs.
* Basic understanding of WebAR, Three.js, or 3D model integration would be an advantage.

**Responsibilities:**

Develop and improve Aroma's existing platform, implement new features, manage frontend and backend systems, ensure application security and performance, resolve technical issues, and maintain complete source code documentation.

**Experience:** 1–3 years preferred. Skilled freshers with strong practical projects may also apply.

**Apply at:** hr@metahud.co  
**Website:** www.metahud.co

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹22,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
We are seeking a proactive and skilled **Full Stack Developer** with **1 to 3 years of hands-on experience** to join our growing engineering team on a full-time remote basis.

In this role, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable web applications from front to back. You will collaborate directly with product management, design, and QA teams to ship clean, efficient, and well-tested code.

*Note: This is a remote position, but candidates* ***must be living in Kolkata*** *to facilitate occasional team meetups, local onboarding, and synchronized working hours.*

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Full Lifecycle Development:** Design, build, test, and deploy end-to-end features using Node.js/Express for backend services and React.js for modern web user interfaces.
* **API Architecture:** Build, document, and consume secure RESTful APIs and modern endpoints (GraphQL integration experience is a plus).
* **Database Management:** Write, optimize, and maintain database schemas and complex queries across both relational (PostgreSQL / MySQL) and non-relational (MongoDB) databases.
* **UI/UX Implementation:** Translate Figma design mockups and product specs into responsive, fast, and accessible cross-browser front-end interfaces.
* **Code Quality & Testing:** Write unit and integration tests, perform code reviews, and optimize application performance and load times.
* **Collaborative Remote Workflow:** Actively participate in agile daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospective meetings using Jira, Slack, and Git/GitHub.

**Requirements & Qualifications:**

* **Experience:** 1 to 3 years of professional full-stack web development experience.
* **Location:** Must currently reside in Kolkata
* **Front-End Stack:** Proficiency in **React.js**, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3/Tailwind CSS, and state management tools (Redux, Zustand, or Context API).
* **Back-End Stack:** Strong hands-on backend development experience with **Node.js** and Express.js.
* **Databases:** Working knowledge of SQL (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and/or NoSQL (MongoDB).
* **Version Control:** Solid experience with **Git/GitHub** workflows (pull requests, branching strategies, rebase/merge).
* **Deployment & Cloud:** Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Vercel, Render) and containerization tools (Docker) is a strong plus.
* **Remote Setup:** Must have a reliable home office setup, high-speed internet connection, and power backup.

**Shift Timings :** US Business Hours

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Work from home

* What is your expected monthly CTC?

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

* Full-stack development: 2 years (Preferred)
